findings.current: I’ll have to settle for loving you from afar.
findings.defect: The Korean explicitly says he must be content even with one-sided love. “Loving you from afar” can suggest physical or emotional distance without preserving that unrequited-love joke.
findings.rationale: 짝사랑 means unrequited love; the line continues the Demon Lord’s flirtatious claim that he has long admired Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: I’ll have to settle for unrequited love.

summary: The assembled English is faithful overall, with one minor loss of nuance in the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s joke.
